negative_or_disconfirming_evidence: Only 2 of 12 original Beaumont populations acquired stochastic switching; earlier lineage history mattered.
Gallie 2015 equivalent genetic change in standard E coli did not reproduce expected phenotype in tested environments.
Gallie 2015 measured capsule-producing phenotype has a growth cost, and mechanistic model uses assumed regulation.
Basan 2020 current high growth can generate long next-transition lag; environmental feed and readiness interventions external.
Kratz 2026 model's exact ribosome subsectors were not directly experimentally validated; authors used prior external data in Figure 1a.
Van den Bergh 2016 persistence reduction after treatment ceased was incomplete and slow.
Awakening assay medium can change inferred fraction of dormant cells without changing underlying ancestor lineage.
